component.name: Meraki
component.summary: Fast, crash-resistant open-source video editor in Rust
Editor de vídeo open-source rápido e estável em Rust

description.p: Meraki is a native open-source video editor built with Rust, Iced (wgpu), and GStreamer Editing Services (GES), focused on rock-solid responsiveness and a clean five-tab workflow: Files, Edit, Effects, Audio, and Delivery.

O Meraki é um editor de vídeo open-source nativo desenvolvido em Rust, Iced (wgpu) e GStreamer Editing Services (GES), projetado para estabilidade extrema sem travamentos e uma interface minimalista organizada em cinco abas: Arquivos, Edição, Efeitos, Áudio e Entrega.

Release v0.4.0 featuring real-time zero-delay audio and mixer controls, a 4-band parametric equalizer with a live spectrum visualizer, double-click individual reset on EQ bands and mixer faders, 6 curated audio presets including Speech/YouTube and Music, Auto-EQ for voice and music, positional timeline transitions with a dedicated Transition Inspector, bilingual PT-BR/EN interface, and proxy cache controls.

Release v0.3.0 introducing real-time preview while dragging inspector sliders, double-click individual parameter reset, J/K/L shuttle playback shortcuts, an individual effect inspector with quick Zoom presets, visual FX badges on timeline clips, a fix for duplicate title text in the preview overlay, and direct timeline clicking to position the playhead.

Release v0.2.0 with Project Hub (recent projects, search, rename/remove), 4 keyboard shortcut profiles (Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, VEGAS Pro), descriptive action tooltips, precision playhead split and frame stepping, and the new Meraki icon identity.
Initial public release v0.1.0 featuring the 5-tab editor, 720p proxy cache, real-time 4-band audio mixer, .meraki project persistence, and native GPU preview.
